reason: PURE. The first thing I looked at was the front: 200 mg and 'no magnesium oxide', then the QR for the batch report. That is what I check on a label, and most TikTok magnesium fails it. I would try one box, but $30 a month is a stretch on my budget.
objection: Two big capsules every day, and $1 a day is more than the plain bisglycinate I can get at a store. I would have to be sure the QR report really shows the magnesium content.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $22-24 per box, or a sample sachet to check the capsule size first.
